notes: Machine-readable infrastructure-cost registry. No cost or price claim may be hard-coded into marketing pages; this file is the single source of truth.
Values were read from the provider documentation on lastVerifiedAt. Free tiers change; re-verify before making external claims.
Entries marked verification=unverified were included for completeness and were NOT confirmed against provider docs in this repository's history.

entries.unitCost: $0 while within the free allowance. Paid plan: $5/month includes 10M requests + 30M CPU-ms, then $0.30/M requests and $0.02/M CPU-ms.
entries.upgradeTrigger: Sustained >100k audit/API requests per day, or a single audit needing >10 ms CPU in the Worker itself (network wait is not CPU).
entries.fallback: Reduce request count (cache static assets, tighten rate limits), or move to the $5/month Workers Paid plan.

entries.freeAllowance: Requests to static assets are free and unlimited
entries.upgradeTrigger: Not applicable for asset requests themselves

entries.freeAllowance: 5 million rows read/day; 100,000 rows written/day; 5 GB total storage
entries.unitCost: Paid plan: first 25B rows read/month, 50M rows written/month and 5 GB included; then $0.001/M rows read, $1.00/M rows written, $0.75/GB-month.
entries.upgradeTrigger: Saved audits / share links (V0.4) exceeding 100k writes/day or 5 GB.
entries.fallback: Reports are downloadable client-side; storage is optional. Not wired in V0.

entries.freeAllowance: 10 GB-month storage; 1M Class A ops/month; 10M Class B ops/month; free egress
entries.unitCost: Standard storage: $0.015/GB-month, $4.50/M Class A, $0.36/M Class B after the free tier.
entries.upgradeTrigger: Storing full HTML snapshots or generated PDFs beyond 10 GB-month (V1+ report artifacts).
entries.fallback: Keep artifacts in memory / client download; R2 only when durable artifacts are genuinely required. Not wired in V0.

entries.freeAllowance: Unlimited challenges/verifications; up to 20 widgets; 10 hostnames per widget
entries.upgradeTrigger: More than 20 widgets or >10 hostnames per widget, or Enterprise features.
entries.fallback: Already optional: when TURNSTILE_SECRET is absent the Worker skips verification and relies on rate limits.

entries.unitCost: $0.011 per 1,000 Neurons beyond the daily free allocation (Workers Paid required).
entries.upgradeTrigger: AI explanations enabled (AI_EXPLANATIONS=on) and used beyond ~10k Neurons/day.
entries.fallback: AI is optional and off by default. Without it, deterministic template text is used; the audit never depends on AI.
entries.notes: Default model @cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct-fp8-fast: about 4,119 Neurons per 1M input tokens and 34,868 per 1M output tokens (one short rephrase call per finding).

entries.freeAllowance: Unlimited standard-runner minutes for public repositories; 500 MB artifact storage
entries.unitCost: $0 for public repositories on standard runners
entries.upgradeTrigger: Repository made private (then 2,000 free minutes/month on GitHub Free).
entries.fallback: Run `pnpm verify` locally; the CI workflow is portable.

entries.unitCost: Usage-based beyond the free tier; billing limits can be set to $0
entries.fallback: Not wired in V0 and disabled by default. If enabled later it must be consent-aware.

entries.unitCost: Per successful card charge (region-dependent, e.g. standard EU cards ~1.5% + EUR 0.25). Confirm current rates before enabling billing.
entries.fallback: Manual invoicing during early pilots; Stripe can be added without changing the audit architecture.
